explanation_short: Ethanol, Acetate, and Butyrate are the features with the highest mean values, and Ethanol also exhibits the highest standard deviation.
explanation_full: The analysis of feature distributions reveals that Ethanol, Acetate, and Butyrate possess the highest mean values, suggesting they are the most prevalent features in the dataset. Ethanol has the highest mean (0.4736) and the highest standard deviation (0.2528). Acetate (0.4465) and Butyrate (0.4287) follow in terms of mean. In contrast, pH has the lowest mean (0.2355) and the lowest standard deviation (0.1267), indicating less variability. These observations highlight the relative importance and spread of key chemical components.
